title: Au, du, they, to taste
summary: à + le = au, de + le = du: au village, au bureau, le poisson du village (Au revoir = 'to the re-seeing'). ils / elles = they. ils peuvent = they can, where the -ent ending is silent. goûter = to taste / try food, essayer de = to try to do something. perdre = to lose.
points: à + le → au: au village, au bureau. (à la and à l' don't change.)
ils = they (masc. or mixed), elles = they (all female). Both sound like il / elle.
ils peuvent = they can. -ent on verbs is silent, but you hear the consonant before it.
Inversion links the t: Pourquoi ne peuvent-ils pas… ?
goûter = to taste (like 'gusto'). essayer de = to try to do something.
More f → p: le poisson (fish, Pisces), pêcher (to fish), la plume (feather).

drills.en: Our father doesn't want to go to the village.
drills.fr: Notre père ne veut pas aller au village.

drills.en: Our father doesn't want to go to the village on foot.
drills.fr: Notre père ne veut pas aller au village à pied.

drills.en: Why can't they go to the office?
drills.fr: Pourquoi ils ne peuvent pas aller au bureau ?

drills.en: Why can't they go to the office? (inverted)
drills.fr: Pourquoi ne peuvent-ils pas aller au bureau ?

drills.en: You have to try the fish.
You have to try the fish from the village.
drills.fr: Tu dois goûter le poisson du village.

drills.en: You have to try to fish.
I don't want to lose it.
drills.fr: Je ne veux pas le perdre.

drills.en: I don't want to lose them.
drills.fr: Je ne veux pas les perdre.
